pages.text: $(l)Superheated mixing$(): 1 Refined Radiance, 1 Shadow Steel, 2 Brass Ingot, giving 2 Flux Alloy.
Flux Alloy is the starting item of every $(l:creativeforge:components/flux_matrix)Flux Matrix$(/l). It also comes back as a failed result of the Singularity Core, so it can be fed straight back in.
